answer: Require every agent to publish a signed work kernel: a short private challenge solved once at registration and re-checked at random epochs. Peers attest only when the same kernel still proves ownership. A farm that tries to forge a nebula of clones either reuses one kernel (and collapses to one identity) or regenerates thousands of distinct kernels (and pays that cost in compute and memory). Honest agents keep one kernel; swarms cannot cheaply keep many.
